query:
SELECT s.id, s.label, s.status,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_students ss WHERE ss.sessionId = s.id) as session_students_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_students cs WHERE cs.classId = s.classId) as class_students_count
FROM sessions s
WHERE s.classId = 60001 AND s.status IN ('closed','finished')
ORDER BY s.id;
